item.title: [+1] Fiscal deficit widens 25.4% to ₹7.15 trillion in April–September, 42.1% of the full-year target
item.description:
Spending rose to ₹25.5 trillion from ₹23 trillion while net tax receipts grew only to ₹12.8 trillion. Higher food and fertiliser subsidies and subdued taxes drove it. New data; worsening.

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Subsidy support

Why it matters: Wider deficits raise the risk of more government borrowing, adding to pressure on G-Sec yields; subsidy costs rise with oil and gas prices.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Bond market (G-Secs) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] Global LNG prices jump 6%, raising gas costs as India imports record volumes
item.description:
Follows record October LNG imports for power, fertiliser and city gas, partly from Qatar. Escalating cost pressure.

Agri & fertilisers: mild headwind (−1) — Fertiliser feedstock

Why it matters: Pricier LNG raises costs for gas-based power, fertiliser and city gas, adding to the subsidy bill and the trade deficit.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
